prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design a new compact app symbol for AppRoute, intended to sit immediately to the LEFT of the attached approved AppRoute brush-script wordmark. Input image: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for stroke rhythm, rounded terminals, moderate thick/thin contrast, slight forward lean and cyan-to-blue color. Do not reproduce or redesign the wordmark. Produce ONLY ONE standalone graphic symbol, no words, no letters unless explicitly required by the direction, no captions, no variants or presentation boards. Crisp smooth flat vector-like silhouette, clear open negative space, sophisticated friendly custom brush lettering character. Medium stroke weight with deliberate thicker downstrokes and slimmer turns, never hairline monoline and never heavy inflated blobs. Cyan #06BCD6 to clean vivid blue #1260F3 gradient, no mint green, no white interior glyph. Transparent background. No enclosing square or circle, no colored app tile, no border, no shadow, no 3D, no shine, no brush texture, no decorative flourishes. Compact nearly-square silhouette centered with about 12 percent clear margin each side, designed to remain readable as a 32-48 pixel app mark. Direction 1: a graceful handwritten branching route. One gently curved lower stem divides into two visibly diverging curved outlets, left shorter and lower, right longer and higher. Two small softly rounded arrow tips should grow organically out of the curved strokes, never oversized road-sign triangles. Use dynamic asymmetric pen-drawn movement with an open V-shaped space between branches, both outlets visibly go in different directions, no parallel upward arrows. The mark should feel written by the same hand as the AppRoute wordmark while conveying choose-a-route. Avoid plant, antlers, person with raised arms, trident, and a stiff Y.
note: 原始箭头原文件保留；应用内随形包边和桌面底板通过固定参数封装，未重新生成箭头或艺术字。
